dct_creator_sm: Zhong, Chiyun (University of Toronto). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7465-0186
dct_description_sm: This dataset includes the results of 254 shaking table tests of a scaled slender MDOF rocking structure that is susceptible to higher modes of vibrations under earthquake loading with (1) a free-rocking base mechanism and (2) uncoupled free-rocking and controlled-rocking dual base mechanisms. This dataset contains five compressed files in ZIP format that are (1) the recorded displacement input and acceleration of each shaking table test, (2) the recorded accelerometer measurements, (3) the recorded 3D movements of the LED markers, (4) the selected test videos, and (5) photos of the specimen.
dct_title_s: Data set from shaking table tests of a slender MDOF structure with base-rocking mechanisms
